keywords.title: Job titles or keywords
keywords.description: What to search for. Each keyword is searched in every location.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Cities or countries, e.g. "Bangalore", "India", "Remote". Leave empty to search worldwide.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max jobs per site
maxItemsPerSource.description: Stop after this many jobs from each site. You only pay for jobs you get.

postedWithin.title: Posted within
postedWithin.description: Newest jobs come first. With "Any time", LinkedIn returns results in its own order, often including jobs months or a year old.

fetchDetails.title: Get full job details
fetchDetails.description: Adds the full description, applicant count, seniority, employment type, industry, salary (when shown) and Easy Apply flag. Priced as a detailed job.

includeDescriptionHtml.title: Include description HTML
includeDescriptionHtml.description: Also return the description as HTML (needs full job details).

onlyNewJobs.title: Only new jobs
onlyNewJobs.description: Skip jobs returned by your previous runs. Ideal for scheduled runs: you only pay for new jobs.

dedupeAcrossSources.title: Remove duplicates across sites
dedupeAcrossSources.description: When the same job (title, company, city) is on several sites, return it once.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy is recommended. The default works for most searches.
